## Definitions

- [statement] Rytary is an oral extended-release carbidopa-levodopa capsule; its beads dissolve and are absorbed at different rates. (medium confidence) — https://www.parkinson.org/living-with-parkinsons/treatment/prescription-medications/levodopa · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery · also: https://www.rytary.com/docs/pi.pdf

## Structure and components

- [statement] CREXONT contains immediate-release carbidopa/levodopa granules and extended-release levodopa pellets, combining rapid and sustained delivery within an oral capsule. (high confidence) — https://crexont.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/CREXONT-Full-Prescribing-Information-August-2024.pdf · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery · also: https://www.parkinson.org/living-with-parkinsons/treatment/prescription-medications/levodopa

## How it works

- [statement] Intestinal levodopa infusion adds procedure and device burdens: DUOPA labeling warns that gastrointestinal procedure-related complications can require surgery or cause death. (low confidence) — https://www.rxabbvie.com/pdf/duopa_pi.pdf · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] DUOPA is carbidopa-levodopa enteral suspension delivered into the jejunum through a PEG-J tube and pump. Its March 2026 label specifies a 16-hour daily infusion, up to 2000 mg levodopa, followed by nighttime oral immediate-release carbidopa-levodopa. (low confidence) — https://www.rxabbvie.com/pdf/duopa_pi.pdf · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery
- [statement] The October 2024 VYALEV label permits infusion during waking hours or for 24 hours, with individualized infusion rates; the maximum recommended daily foslevodopa dose is 3,525 mg, approximately equivalent to 2,500 mg levodopa. (low confidence) — https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2024/216962s000lbl.pdf · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery
- [statement] The July 2026 INBRIJA label specifies inhaling two 42 mg capsules (84 mg) per OFF episode, up to five times daily, with a 420 mg daily maximum. Capsules are inhaled using the INBRIJA inhaler and must not be swallowed. (low confidence) — https://www.inbrija.com/prescribing-information.pdf · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Foscarbidopa and foslevodopa are prodrugs converted in vivo to carbidopa and levodopa. The October 2024 VYALEV label indicates subcutaneous pump infusion for motor fluctuations in adults with advanced Parkinson’s disease. (high confidence) — https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2024/216962s000lbl.pdf · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery · also: https://www.parkinson.org/living-with-parkinsons/treatment/prescription-medications/levodopa
- [statement] INBRIJA labeling does not recommend use in asthma, COPD, or other chronic underlying lung disease because of bronchospasm risk; cough is among its common adverse reactions. (low confidence) — https://www.inbrija.com/prescribing-information.pdf · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery
- [statement] Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma announced on October 23, 2025 that the US FDA had issued a complete response letter for the new drug application of investigational ND0612 for motor fluctuations in people with Parkinson's disease, with FDA observations regarding the manufacturing site and the nonclinical information. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-10-23) — https://www.tanabe-pharma.com/en/news/news20251023103060.html · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery
- [statement] Tanabe Pharma announced that Onerji (project code ND0612), a continuous subcutaneous infusion of liquid levodopa/carbidopa, received European Commission marketing authorization on April 27 (local time) for motor fluctuations in advanced Parkinson's disease not sufficiently controlled by oral anti-Parkinson medicinal products; the NeuroDerm news listing dates that announcement April 30, 2026. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-30) — https://www.neuroderm.com/our-company/news-and-events/eu-marketing-authorization-for-onerji/ · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery · also: https://www.neuroderm.com/our-company/news-and-events/tanabe-pharma-announces-wind-down-of-operations-at-its-wholly-owned-subsidiary-neuroderm-ltd/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Conversion from immediate-release carbidopa-levodopa to CREXONT is not a 1:1 dose substitution; use formulation-specific conversion and titration rather than matching milligrams. (high confidence) — https://crexont.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/CREXONT-Full-Prescribing-Information-August-2024.pdf · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery · also: https://www.parkinson.org/living-with-parkinsons/treatment/prescription-medications/levodopa
- [statement] In RISE-PD, 506 participants were randomized; IPX203 increased daily good ON time by a least-squares mean 0.53 hours versus immediate-release carbidopa-levodopa (95% CI 0.09–0.97), with mean dosing approximately three versus five times daily. Good ON meant ON without troublesome dyskinesia. (low confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10425876/ · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery
- [statement] RISE-PD compared IPX203 with immediate-release carbidopa-levodopa in patients already experiencing fluctuations. It did not establish efficacy in early PD versus placebo or prevention of later motor complications; protocol dosing was limited to no more often than every 6 hours. (low confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10425876/ · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery
- [statement] VYALEV’s pivotal-study safety data in the October 2024 label report infusion-site reactions in 62% versus 8% with placebo infusion and site infections in 28% versus 3%; adverse reactions led to VYALEV discontinuation in 22%. These are study-specific rates, not comparisons against intestinal infusion. (low confidence) — https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2024/216962s000lbl.pdf · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery
- [statement] Inhaled levodopa (INBRIJA) is an intermittent treatment for OFF episodes in patients already treated with carbidopa/levodopa, rather than a stand-alone maintenance formulation. (high confidence) — https://www.inbrija.com/prescribing-information.pdf · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery · also: https://www.parkinson.org/living-with-parkinsons/treatment/prescription-medications/levodopa
- [statement] In the foslevodopa-foscarbidopa phase 3 trial, continuous subcutaneous infusion improved ON time without troublesome dyskinesia and reduced OFF time compared with oral immediate-release levodopa-carbidopa, but infusion-site events were frequent and more participants discontinued treatment because of adverse events. (low confidence) — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36402160/ · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Levodopa is converted to dopamine in the brain. Carbidopa inhibits peripheral levodopa decarboxylation, increasing levodopa availability to the brain and reducing peripheral nausea and vomiting; it does not remove central levodopa adverse effects. (high confidence) — https://www.parkinson.org/living-with-parkinsons/treatment/prescription-medications/levodopa · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery · also: https://www.rxabbvie.com/pdf/duopa_pi.pdf
- [statement] Oral carbidopa-levodopa is supplied as immediate-release tablets, controlled-release tablets, and extended-release capsules; the Parkinson’s Foundation describes Rytary as containing beads absorbed at different rates. (low confidence) — https://www.parkinson.org/living-with-parkinsons/treatment/prescription-medications/levodopa · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery
- [statement] Fewer dosing occasions did not mean fewer pills in RISE-PD: mean daily pill counts were 10.6 with IPX203 and 8.7 with immediate-release treatment, with the trial restricted to one strength of each formulation. (low confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10425876/ · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery
- [statement] The December 2019 Rytary prescribing information instructs patients not to chew, divide or crush the capsules; for difficulty swallowing, it permits opening a capsule and immediately consuming its entire contents sprinkled on applesauce. (low confidence) — https://www.rytary.com/docs/pi.pdf · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery
- [statement] BouNDless studied ND0612 as continuous subcutaneous levodopa-carbidopa solution, with supplemental oral levodopa-carbidopa if needed; its randomized phase followed open-label optimization of both regimens. (low confidence) — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38499015/ · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery
- [statement] BouNDless reported more ON time without troublesome dyskinesia with ND0612 than with oral levodopa-carbidopa, while infusion-site reactions were its most common adverse events; the study findings should not be treated as a statement of regulatory approval. (low confidence) — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38499015/ · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery
- [statement] A NeuroDerm news page carries Tanabe Pharma's announcement of its decision to wind down the operations of its wholly owned subsidiary NeuroDerm Ltd., the company developing ND0612. (medium confidence) — https://www.neuroderm.com/our-company/news-and-events/tanabe-pharma-announces-wind-down-of-operations-at-its-wholly-owned-subsidiary-neuroderm-ltd/ · keywords: Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery · also: https://www.tanabe-pharma.com/en/news/news20251023103060.html

## Research summary — Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery

Levodopa supplies the dopamine precursor, while carbidopa reduces peripheral conversion and associated nausea. Delivery options include immediate- and controlled-release tablets, extended-release capsules, intestinal carbidopa-levodopa infusion, subcutaneous foscarbidopa/foslevodopa infusion, and intermittent inhaled levodopa. Extended-release oral formulations aim to sustain benefit with fewer dosing occasions, but conversion requires formulation-specific titration. Infusions can provide sustained delivery while adding tube, pump, procedure, or skin-site burdens. Inhaled levodopa addresses OFF episodes alongside existing carbidopa/levodopa treatment. RISE-PD supports IPX203 over immediate-release treatment in patients with fluctuations; it does not establish prevention of future motor complications. Product-specific labels distinguish routes, dose equivalence, and delivery limitations. Regulatory status of subcutaneous ND0612 is time-sensitive: a US complete response letter was announced on October 23, 2025, and EU marketing authorization was announced in April 2026.
